description: ERR-ADO, variant: which later calls clear a Connection's Errors? On one Connection (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, read-only), each case first runs the provider failure Execute 'SELEC ID FROM T' and reads Errors, then does ONE of: (1) successful Execute of 'SELECT ID FROM T'; (2) a property get (State); (3) MoveNext on a recordset opened earlier; (4) an ADO runtime failure (Properties.Item 'NoSuchProp'); (5) the held Errors.Clear; and reads Errors again.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
